summary: A notes board where every change is code: engineers edit Python, SQL or environment variables and cut a release. No backup, no undo, no signals, no AI.

archetype.reason: A single-purpose notes board for one team, not a platform.

persistent_data.reason: Notes are stored in SQLite at /data/notes.db.

schema_changes.reason: The notes table changes over time by hand-run ALTER TABLE statements.

multi_tenant.reason: One team, no accounts: anyone on the VPN uses the same board.

hosted_service.reason: A long-lived gunicorn web service in a container.

agent_mutations.reason: No AI or agent anywhere in the code.

evolution_auto_apply.reason: There is no evolution loop at all.

definition_change_path.reason: The only configuration is environment variables read at start (page size, database path); with no evolution system this is the one change path the rubric allows.

code_release_path.reason: Ordinary CI and a hand-run deploy script are not a first-party evolution system (rule 12), and no AI writes code.

ai_features.reason: No model calls; search is a SQL LIKE.

MAL-02.reason: Fields are columns in schema.sql; adding one is a code change.

MAL-07.reason: The page layout is a template string in app.py.

MAL-09.reason: Title and help text are Python constants.

MAL-10.reason: No rules engine; the only behaviour is coded routes.

MAL-20.reason: No conversational surface of any kind.

DEL-01.reason: Requests live in a chat channel outside the product.

DEL-05.reason: Tests run on pull requests but draft pull requests are skipped.

DEL-06.reason: A health endpoint with no version or configuration snapshot.

DEL-10.reason: Nothing can be switched off without a release; at most an engineer edits an environment variable and restarts.

DEL-11.reason: code_release_path is false: no evolution system ships code.

ARC-02.reason: Schema changes are hand-run SQL, the anchor for 0.

ARC-03.reason: One process with its state in SQLite on local disk.

ARC-05.reason: multi_tenant is false: one team, no accounts.

ARC-09.reason: The only backup is a Makefile target that prints TODO; nothing copies or restores data.

LRN-02.reason: No feedback, rating or usage signal is recorded.

LRN-03.reason: Unhandled errors are logged for engineers; nothing user-facing is recorded in the product.

LRN-08.reason: The product produces no learned or AI-made changes and no check would apply to one (rubric LRN-08 boundary).

LRN-10.reason: The only checks are tests in code, changed only when engineers edit them.

GOV-02.reason: At most a log line when a note is deleted; no audit store.

GOV-04.reason: No permission model; the dependency scan runs only when started by hand and gates nothing.

GOV-05.reason: Configuration and text are versioned only in git, for engineers.

GOV-06.reason: Pull requests for code are the only proposal path.

EXP-04.reason: The README claims failed searches are tracked, but search records nothing.

main_count.reason: Categories and help text are most of the requests.

all_reach.reason: Every kind of change is a pull request and a release.

kinds.label: categories
kinds.reason: Categories are a Python list; the README's settings page does not exist.

kinds.label: help text
kinds.reason: Help text is a Python constant.

request.reason: No main kind is self-serve and there is no AI lane.

fix.reason: Same build path, and no user-facing issue detection.

expansion.reason: No expansion path; EXP-02 is excluded for a focused application and DEL-04 is 0.
